headline: A much stronger US jobs report raised bets on a December Fed rate hike; bitcoin is holding near $76,000 while US tech stocks bounce.

market.asOf: All three from CoinMarketCap, read about 16:00 UTC Fri 6 Nov (CoinGecko could not be reached this run). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Both in Fear: CoinMarketCap's own index read 32 at about 16:00 UTC; KuCoin's daily report showed a Fear & Greed Index of 28, down from 50, as of 00:00 UTC.

stories.title: US jobs smash forecasts, Fed hike bets rise; bitcoin holds near $76,000
stories.summary: The US added 165,000 jobs in October, far more than expected, and unemployment fell to 4.1%. Traders now see a higher chance the Fed raises rates on 9 December. Bitcoin dipped briefly after the release, then settled back near $76,000 while tech stocks rebounded from Thursday's sell-off.
points: Payrolls rose 165,000 against a 65,000 estimate per CoinDesk; Bitcoin Magazine and CryptoPotato put the forecast at 59,000. September was revised up to 60,000 and unemployment was 4.1% versus 4.2% expected.
Average hourly earnings rose 0.4% on the month and 3.1% on the year, both above forecasts, per CoinDesk.
Odds of a December Fed hike rose to about 79% per CME FedWatch (via Bitcoin Magazine) and 78% per BNN Bloomberg, from about 70% before the report.
Bitcoin fell from $76,000 to $75,200 right after the release, then erased almost all of the losses, per CryptoPotato; CoinDesk described a tight range near $76,000 at 9:53am ET.
After the open, the Nasdaq was up 2% and the S&P 500 up 1%, with a chip-stock ETF up 6.5%, while the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.877%, per CoinDesk at 9:53am ET.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds lose $430M on 5 Nov; November outflows near $870M
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds (ETFs) saw large withdrawals on Thursday. When money leaves these funds there are fewer big buyers in the market.
points: Net outflow of $430.2M on 5 Nov, led by Fidelity's FBTC (-$199.9M) and BlackRock's IBIT (-$105M), per Gate citing Farside.
Outflows were $1.513B over five trading days and $869.8M so far in November, per the same report.
For the year, PANews citing Farside puts net outflows at about $416M.
More than $1.27B of leveraged bets were forcibly closed in 24 hours, over $1.1B of them bets on rising prices, per CoinDesk's Daybook.

sources.label: Gate (Farside data): 5 Nov bitcoin ETF flows
CoinDesk Daybook: $1B of bullish bets liquidated

stories.title: Binance hack: attackers may have had eight weeks of access
stories.summary: New research says the hackers behind Binance's roughly $6.3B loss were inside its systems for weeks before the 29 October attack, and stolen coins are still being moved. Binance says almost all customer funds have been replaced.
points: Security Alliance (SEAL) estimates about eight weeks of access beginning in September, per Cointelegraph; Binance says it started with a fake job interview that compromised an employee's device.
Elliptic traced about 42 million XRP (about $50M) swapped into bitcoin, mostly through THORChain, with about $3.11B still in traced addresses, per CoinTurk.
Binance has frozen or intercepted about $2.85B and puts total losses at $6.34B, per the same report.
About 98% had been replenished as of 4 Nov, and Binance's proof of reserves now covers 44 tokens, per CoinGabbar.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: hackers had 8 weeks of access

briefs.title: White House reviews SEC crypto broker rule
briefs.summary: An SEC draft changing broker-dealer capital and custody rules for crypto went to the White House regulatory office on 3 Nov; the text is not public yet, per Unchained.

briefs.title: 401(k) investment rule reaches final review
briefs.summary: The Labor Department's final rule on choosing 401(k) options went to the White House on 5 Nov; it could make room for crypto in retirement plans, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: House Democrats weigh their own crypto bill
briefs.summary: With Democrats set to control Congress, they are discussing a market-structure bill with a bigger SEC role; the Clarity Act failed a Senate cloture vote 49-50 on 15 Sept, per Bitcoin Magazine.

briefs.title: Robinhood and SoFi slide with bitcoin
briefs.summary: On 5 Nov Robinhood fell 12% and SoFi 9% as bitcoin dropped and an analyst said the Clarity Act is off the table for the lame-duck session, per 24/7 Wall St.

briefs.title: Korean stocks plunge overnight
briefs.summary: Korea's Kospi fell as much as 8.8%, triggering a 20-minute trading halt, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: World Liberty plans a token buyback
briefs.summary: WLFI plans to buy back tokens after a 66% slide this year, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Greece taxes crypto gains at 10%
briefs.summary: Greece approved a 10% tax on crypto gains and a 15% levy on DeFi income, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Staking INJ fund lists on Nasdaq
briefs.summary: Canary's staking-enabled Injective (INJ) ETF began trading on Nasdaq and INJ rose more than 10% intraday, per KuCoin's daily report.

calendar.note: Expected: +0.3% headline and core on the month, per Economic Weekly. September: +1.3% on the month and 6.3% on the year, per PNC.

The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on 28 Oct in a 10-2 vote, with Cook and Hammack voting for a hike. After the jobs report, hike odds are about 79% per CME FedWatch (via Bitcoin Magazine); Polymarket showed 70%.
